MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 81
   C. 40.5
   D. 9

2. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

3. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 1

4. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

5. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 13
   C. 40
   D. 3

6. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 30
   C. 18
   D. 45

8. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 22

9. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 31
   D. 37

10. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

11. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/2
   D. They are equal

12. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

13. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 1
   C. 12
   D. 7

14. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 17
   C. 25
   D. 31

15. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 49

16. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.205
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.025

17. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 90

18. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 1

19. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27
   C. 33
   D. 27.7

20. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

21. Solve for x: x + 6 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 6
   C. 4
   D. 5

22. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

23. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 15.6
   D. 15.7

24. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 4
   D. 33

25. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 14
   C. 22
   D. 33

26. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 49

27. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 23
   D. 29

28. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 81
   C. 82
   D. 18

29. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 17
   C. 73
   D. 1

30. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 25
   D. 10

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
